notes: Self-declared "Incremental / RNG collector", and incremental is Simulation's own territory — the number going up is the game — so Incremental Simulator is the preset and Simulation's world-open shape applies in its own words: no personal plot, one shared persistent world all players operate in, which the answers confirm is a single small map with five biome regions ringing the Spawn Hub. Not tier-ladder or Stat Grinder despite the luck grind, because no barrier is a stat threshold; the regions are freely walkable, which is also why I dropped the preset's gate-progression. The roll station is station-training as the repeatable pad the loop runs on, the workbench is trigger-task, crafting materials are collectible-nodes, and the vendor and quest NPCs are npc-population. The prompt explicitly puts the workbench in a building or room, so building-interior is required and it routes P3 — that is the only thing carrying the modifier, so it collapses to P0 if the crafting area is built as an open-air pavilion instead. Biome rotation, luck maths, RNG, DataStore, and every UI overlay are systems with no geometry, and the count worth carrying is five physical biome regions.
